products.product_description: Pink's Ice Cream - Black Sesame. 16 oz Paper Carton and 1 gallon plastic container
products.code_info: That six digit code will start with two numbers between 00**** and 52****. The recall includes all codes within that range with the exclusion of 01**** and 41****.
products.reason_for_recall: Pink's Ice Cream is recalling all products made with a raw material that there is a potential for the raw material to be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes.
